title: Pangilinan says Chinese envoy may face ‘firing squad’ for defying Beijing

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan took a swipe at Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan, suggesting that diplomats who defy Beijing could face severe punishment upon returning home. “The arrogance and bullying tactics are unprecedented and deplorable but that’s probably because should these diplomats fail to toe the Party line they could very well be called back home to face the firing squad,” Pangilinan said in a social media post on Monday. Pangilinan’s remarks came amid mounting criticism of Jing over his statement that China could “easily win” in a confrontation with the Philippines if it resorted to […]...
